context: Documentary discussion: Asuka and Ren on early-2000s policy.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: documentary discussion; vocabulary (攻撃/禁止/否定/積極/イラク/小泉) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 当時、小泉政権は積極的でしたね。
lines.en: Back then, the Koizumi government was proactive.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、小泉氏は積極的に動きました。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: イラクへの対応は、難しかったですか?
lines.en: Was the response to Iraq difficult?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: イラクの事情は、非常に複雑でした。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 武力攻撃は、禁止されていたはずでは?
lines.en: Wasn't armed attack supposed to be banned?
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 禁止の解釈を巡り、否定し合いました。
lines.en: They denied each other over the ban's interpretation.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 小泉氏は、批判を否定したんですか?
lines.en: Did Mr. Koizumi deny the criticism?
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 一部は否定し、積極的に説明しました。
lines.en: He denied part of it and explained proactively.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
